target: skills/review/SKILL.md step 9 — pushes and opens through forge.sh push / pr-create, records the printed value, keeps pr: local, says PR/MR, no git push -u origin
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"
R="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/review/SKILL.md"
fx_has "$R" 'scripts/lib/forge.sh push' names_push
fx_has "$R" 'pr-create' names_prcreate
fx_has "$R" 'git push -u origin' stale_push
fx_has "$R" 'pr: local' keeps_local
fx_has "$R" 'PR/MR' says_prmr
fx_has "$R" 'pr:' records_pr
